title: 04 · Table Chorus — A place for you

screenshotVerification.method: T3 initial board creation using window.editor; isolated Playwright browser screenshots after T3 host disconnect; local images inspected with view_image.

remotePersistence.note: A fresh anonymous browser context read the previously saved remote shapes before source replay, then reload retained all shapes. No authentication or local snapshot loading was needed.

connectorLimitation: tldraw MCP open_board returned opening, exec reported board not open. Browser editor worked; T3 host subsequently disconnected. No repeated T3 retries.
